derivatives_policy: AT&T uses derivatives to manage interest rate risk and foreign currency exchange risk, including cross-currency swaps designated as fair value hedges; does not use derivatives for trading or speculative purposes

AT&T uses cross-currency swaps on foreign currency-denominated debt instruments designated as fair value hedges to manage foreign currency exchange rates and interest rate risk; does not use derivatives for trading or speculative purposes

AT&T uses fixed-to-fixed and floating-to-fixed cross-currency swaps on foreign currency-denominated debt designated as fair value or cash flow hedges to manage FX and interest rate risk; does not use derivatives for trading or speculative purposes

AT&T employs derivatives to manage interest rate and foreign currency exchange risks, including interest rate swaps, interest rate locks, foreign currency exchange contracts and cross-currency swaps; does not use derivatives for trading or speculative purposes

AT&T uses fixed-to-fixed and floating-to-fixed cross-currency swaps on foreign currency-denominated debt designated as fair value or cash flow hedges to manage FX and interest rate risk; does not use derivatives for trading or speculative purposes

AT&T uses fixed-to-fixed and floating-to-fixed cross-currency swaps on foreign currency-denominated debt to hedge exposure to changes in foreign currency exchange rates and interest rates; these derivatives are designated as fair value or cash flow hedges.
